verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents programmatic API access through service accounts for automation and CI/CD, dashboards-as-code (the JSON editor note implies a dashboard API), and an official MCP server plus Agent Skills that query telemetry, create and modify dashboards, manage alerts, and save Explorer views. Nothing states or shows that every UI action is available through the API, and no public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec covering all features (e.g. log pipelines, roles, public dashboard publishing, SSO config), and independent corroboration of API coverage.
